content.title: Kroger Easter hours 2026: Is Kroger open on Easter Sunday
content.text: Plenty of retailers and restaurants close on Easter Sunday. But if on Easter morning, which this year is Sunday, April 5, you discover you’re missing a few essential items for your holiday festivities, you might wonder: Is Kroger open on Easter? Whether you need chocolate eggs, a honey-baked ham, or sparkling wine for mimosas, Kroger could be your go-to. Kroger is known for its budget-friend holiday meal deals. These are especially welcome during these times of inflation and increasing food costs, so if you have a Kroger in your neighborhood, it might be the place you head to first. Unlike many grocers that close for the holiday, Kroger typically keeps its doors open. So here's the short answer: Yes, most Kroger stores are open on Easter Sunday. However, hours may be reduced depending on location. Some locations may close earlier than usual, and pharmacy hours are often more limited than hours for the main grocery store. Most Kroger locations will be open from 6 a.m. until 10 p.m. but because Kroger operates thousands of stores nationwide, customers are encouraged to check their local store using the Kroger app or website before heading out. The following brands operate under the Kroger umbrella and these stores’ hours may also be limited on Easter. Baker’s, City Market Dillons Food 4 Less Foods Co Fred Meyer Fry’s Gerbes Jay C Food Store King Soopers Mariano’s Metro Market Pay-Less Super Markets Pick’n Save QFC Ralphs Ruler Smith’s Food and Drug One thing that makes Kroger especially popular during holidays like Easter is its focus on convenience and meal packages that simplify meal planning. The company has built a reputation for offering ready-to-make holiday meal bundles and affordable packages that take the stress out of hosting. In recent years, Kroger has promoted complete Easter meal deals featuring ham, sides, and dessert for as little as about $6 per person, giving families a budget-friendly way to prepare a full holiday spread. Customers can also order prepared meals, ready-to-heat options, and full ingredient bundles online for pickup or delivery. Kroger operates thousands of stores in the U.S.; customers appreciate the stores for its meal deals. Houston Chronicle/Hearst Newspapers on Getty Images · Houston Chronicle/Hearst Newspapers on Getty Images Just as the company does for every holiday, Kroger has plenty of deals for Easter. For Easter 2026, Kroger offers: Ham for as little as 85 cents a pound. Fresh spring vegetables, including asparagus, for $1.99 per pound. King's Hawaiian Rolls for $3.99. While Kroger stays open on Easter, there are also plenty of grocers that close. That list includes: Aldi BJs Costco Lidl Publix Sam’s Club Target Founded in 1883 in Cincinnati, Ohio, by Bernard Kroger, The Kroger Co. has become the largest supermarket chain in the United States and, according to Statista, is now one of the largest overall retailers, behind retail giant Walmart. Kroger reported quarterly revenue of roughly $45 billion Adjusted earnings per share came in at about $1.49 per share. Identical sales (excluding fuel) rose about 3.2%. E-commerce sales increased roughly 15% year over year. Kroger expects identical sales growth of 1% to 2% for 2026. Source: Kroger Related: Target quietly stops competing with Walmart, Kroger in major area This story was originally published by TheStreet on Apr 5, 2026, where it first appeared in the Retail section.
